name: Quality
description: ESS-0005 Quality Center: executable Chapter-12 validation, commit-bound Contract/Test/Build evidence, eight quality gates, deterministic quality scoring, technical-debt and coverage evidence, EventMesh lifecycle publication and read-only SC-MD-SPT FinTech value-chain homogeneity projection.

events.note: Quality lifecycle events use the existing EventMesh composition adapter. Event delivery never authorizes merge, release, deployment or production mutation.

implementedAreas: CoverageCollector with executable-test-area measurement and optional real code-coverage ingestion
real Test Score provider from mandatory test-area coverage
real Security Score provider from established SecurityComplianceAuditor aggregation semantics
TechnicalDebtRegister with evidence-required resolution and lifecycle event publication
EventMesh lifecycle publication through existing EventBus
read-only 14-stage SC-MD-SPT FinTech value-chain homogeneity projection
Quality hot-path isolation validation for MarketData, Scoring, Ranking, Orchestrator and application runtime

mandatoryValidatorImplementationCoverage.note: Implementation availability is not repository conformance. Chapter12ValidationReport carries actual PASS/FAIL/NOT_AVAILABLE evidence.

intentionalEvidenceBoundaries: Documentation, Architecture, Knowledge, Metadata and Twin quality-score axes remain absent until an existing authority defines a deterministic numeric source; Quality Center never invents a formula.
line/branch/function/statement coverage remains NOT_AVAILABLE unless a real coverage-summary artifact exists.
FinTech value-chain projection validates structural/evidence connectivity and hot-path isolation; it never changes financial scores, confidence, ranking, provider routing or eligibility.

authorityBoundary: Quality results are measurement/evidence only and cannot authorize merge, release, deployment, production mutation, policy changes, financial scoring changes, ranking changes or privilege elevation.
